title: WebVibe: Multimodal Interactive Website Generation via Reverse Synthesis and Visual Self-Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2611.34292v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Although multimodal large language models translate single screenshots into static HTML, generating interactive functional websites from design specifications still struggles with multi-page routing and stateful widget transitions. Examining existing training pipelines reveals two bottlenecks: (1) in forward data synthesis (X -> Y), writing the specification X before code execution leaves unimplemented or altered requirements in X as supervision noise; and (2) in reinforcement learning, scalar rewards discard the rich state transitions observed during replay. Based on these findings, we introduce WebVibe and Interactive-SDPO to train InteractiveCoder. WebVibe reverses synthesis into Y -> X by verifying cross-page and in-page interactions in the browser before deriving multimodal inputs from replay-confirmed states to build the 31,542-site WebVibe-32K corpus with reusable execution contracts. translated_title: WebVibe：基于反向合成与视觉自蒸馏的多模态交互式网站生成
translated_abstract: 尽管多模态大语言模型能够将单张截图转换为静态HTML，但从设计规范生成交互式功能网站在多页面路由和有状态组件转换方面仍然面临挑战。检视现有训练流程揭示了两个瓶颈：(1) 在前向数据合成（X -> Y）中，在代码执行之前编写规范X，会使得X中未实现或被更改的需求成为监督噪声；(2) 在强化学习中，标量奖励丢弃了回放过程中观察到的丰富状态转换。基于这些发现，我们提出WebVibe和Interactive-SDPO来训练InteractiveCoder。WebVibe将合成过程反转为Y -> X，通过在浏览器中验证跨页面和页面内交互，再从回放确认的状态中导出多模态输入，构建了包含31,542个网站、带有可复用执行契约的WebVibe-32K语料库。Interactive-SDPO随后基于权重……
tldr: 该论文提出WebVibe方法，通过将数据合成过程反转为先在浏览器中验证交互行为、再生成多模态规范的方式，构建了包含31,542个网站及可复用执行契约的WebVibe-32K语料库，并结合Interactive-SDPO训练出InteractiveCoder，有效解决了从设计规范生成交互式网站时的多页面路由和有状态组件转换难题。
en_tdlr: WebVibe reverses the data synthesis pipeline (Y -> X) by verifying cross-page and in-page interactions in the browser before generating specifications, building the 31,542-site WebVibe-32K corpus with reusable execution contracts, and trains InteractiveCoder with Interactive-SDPO to tackle multi-page routing and stateful widget transition challenges in interactive website generation.
